answer: Each agent must solve a lattice-based proof-of-work keyed to a hardware enclave's sealed attestation, binding identity to a unique silicon vertex that cannot be cloned without detectable side-channel leakage. A rotating ember of entropy seeds the enclave's nonce, while a willow-derived Merkle schedule throttles registration epochs so that spawning identities costs. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
